standard.summary: 训练日志文件（TensorBoard 格式）的保存目录。pytorch_cuda_expandable_segments 优化 CUDA 内存分配策略，cuda_cache_release 控制 CUDA 缓存释放频率。
standard.effect: logging_dir 设置后可以用 tensorboard --logdir 查看训练曲线；pytorch_cuda_expandable_segments=True 允许 CUDA 分配器动态扩展内存段，减少碎片；cuda_cache_release 定期调用 torch.cuda.empty_cache()（通常不需要，PyTorch 自动管理）。
standard.whenToUse: logging_dir 在需要 TensorBoard 可视化时设置；pytorch_cuda_expandable_segments=True 在显存碎片严重（OOM 但 reserved >> allocated）时尝试。
standard.avoidWhen: cuda_cache_release 频率过高会在 empty_cache 时引入额外同步开销；通常 PyTorch 的自动内存管理已足够好，不需要手动干预。

standard_en.summary: Where the training log files (in TensorBoard format) are saved. pytorch_cuda_expandable_segments tunes the CUDA allocation strategy, and cuda_cache_release sets how often the CUDA cache is released.
standard_en.effect: With logging_dir set you can run tensorboard --logdir to see the curves; pytorch_cuda_expandable_segments=True lets the CUDA allocator grow memory segments dynamically, reducing fragmentation; cuda_cache_release calls torch.cuda.empty_cache() periodically (usually unnecessary, since PyTorch manages this itself).
standard_en.whenToUse: Set logging_dir when you want TensorBoard visualisation; try pytorch_cuda_expandable_segments=True when fragmentation is severe (an OOM with reserved far above allocated).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Releasing the cache too often adds synchronisation overhead at each empty_cache; PyTorch's automatic memory management is usually good enough without intervention.

advanced.principle: pytorch_cuda_expandable_segments：新的 CUDA 内存分配器策略（PyTorch 2.0+），允许将已分配的内存段动态扩展（而非固定大小段），减少因碎片导致的 OOM（reserved 高但无法分配连续内存的场景）。gloo/nccl_socket_ifname 指定分布式训练的网络接口，多机训练时防止使用错误的网卡（如 loopback 接口）。
advanced.tradeoffs: expandable_segments 在某些 CUDA 版本（<12.0）下可能有兼容性问题；分布式训练的 socket_ifname 错误配置会导致节点间通信失败（报 timeout 错误）。

advanced_en.principle: pytorch_cuda_expandable_segments: the new CUDA allocator policy (PyTorch 2.0+) allowing allocated memory segments to expand dynamically (rather than fixed-size segments), reducing fragmentation-driven OOM (high reserved but unable to allocate contiguous memory). gloo/nccl_socket_ifname specifies the distributed-training network interface, preventing the wrong NIC (e.g. loopback) in multi-node training.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: expandable_segments may have compatibility issues on some CUDA versions (<12.0); a misconfigured socket_ifname breaks inter-node communication (timeout errors).
